MICROSOFT FACES MURPHY'S LAW  What with Wall Street, the EU, users and a raft of 
more nimble competitors all gunning for Microsoft, it's no wonder the company is 
opening APIs and its wallet  but the road ahead is full of potholes. Read on:

MACBOOK AIR VS. THINKPAD X300: WHICH IS GREENER?  True, theyre both slim, cool and, 
to some, even sexy. But which is the most eco-friendly little laptop? Read on: 
http://weblog.infoworld.com/sustainableit/archives/2008/02/macbook_air_thi.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28
 

AN OLD VISUAL STUDIO PROBLEM REARS ITS UGLY HEAD  An odd occurrence in Visual Studio 
NET continues to nag in VS08. Read on: 
http://weblog.infoworld.com/stratdev/archives/2008/02/an_old_visual_s.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28

 
JOTSPOT REBORN AS GOOGLE SITES  The new Google Apps piece debuts as a wiki 
alternative to Microsoft SharePoint or Lotus Notes. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/28/JotSpot-re-emerges-as-Google-Sites_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28
 

PAYPAL: AVOID APPLE'S SAFARI  Lacking two key security features, Apple's software 
fails to make PayPal's list of recommended browsers. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/28/PayPal-warns-Steer-clear-of-Apple-Safari-browser_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28

 
HEALTHCARE ORGANIZATIONS SEE CYBERATTACKS AS GROWING THREAT  What with data-laden 
laptops disappearing, an uptick in attacks, and the looming possibility of an audit, 
healthcare specialists are ratcheting up their efforts to protect patient information. 
Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/28/Healthcare-organizations-see-cyberattacks-as-growing-threat_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28
 

ORACLES BEA BUY GETS APPROVED  The U.S. DOJ and FTC both gave an affirmative nod to 
Oracles proposed acquisition, bringing the deal closer to finality. Read on: 
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/27/DOJ-clears-Oracles-BEA-acquisition_1.html?source=NLC-DAILY&cgd=2008-02-28
